features.cite: Zertal 2005 (Eng. Vol. 4) Site 112, p. 342; plan fig. 222, p. 343 ('Cistern' symbol)
features.quote: Close to the large courtyard were found rock-cut installations, a cistern

date.basis: only site-level pottery; cistern not dated

notes: One cistern (data block 'Cisterns: 1'). Position 'none': the text gives no direction from the site. The plan (fig. 222; north arrow points to page-left, scale 0-20 m) puts the cistern about 60 m W of the main courtyard (part 1). But the 10-dunam site has three separate parts and the plan has no grid. I could not place the unit point on it: the cistern's bearing from candidate centres runs from about 271 deg (part 1) to about 325 deg (centre of all remains), so no plan position is given. The 'rock-cut installations' are not described further and are not coded. The walls from the round courtyards towards the stream ('perhaps serving as dams', 'Dam?' on the plan) are not pools.
